declarations.lean_elaborated_type: @Prosa.Util.Supremum.choose_superior : {T : Type u_1} → (T → T → Bool) → T → Option T → Option T
declarations.lean_computational_body_evidence:
def Prosa.Util.Supremum.choose_superior.{u} : {T : Type u} → (T → T → Bool) → T → Option T → Option T :=
fun {T} R x maybeY =>
  match maybeY with
  | some y => if R x y = true then some x else some y
  | none => some x

declarations.lean_computational_body_evidence:
def Prosa.Util.Supremum.supremum.{u} : {T : Type u} → (T → T → Bool) → List T → Option T :=
fun {T} R s => List.foldr (Prosa.Util.Supremum.choose_superior R) none s

declarations.semantic_relation: Option equality composed from certified supremum and choose_superior relations
